description: Golden input -> expected output cases for the DeterministicRules cleanup pipeline. Every platform (Rust core, and any Kotlin/TS port) must pass these exact cases. 'must_pass' marks the examples named in the build prompt.

cases.input: Let's meet at 2 PM... actually make that 3 PM
cases.expected: Let's meet at 3 PM.

cases.input: Schedule the meeting for Monday at 3 PM. Actually, make that 4 PM.
cases.expected: Schedule the meeting for Monday at 4 PM.

cases.input: Revenue increased by 15 percent. Sorry, it increased by 12 percent.
cases.expected: Revenue increased by 12 percent.

cases.input: So, um, I think, you know, we should probably review the budget again.
cases.expected: So, I think we should probably review the budget again.

cases.note: No list command is triggered and no full stop is invented.
cases.input: I have two points to make
cases.expected: I have two points to make

cases.input: I have two points to make.
cases.expected: I have two points to make.

cases.input: The call is at 3 PM... actually, 4 PM
cases.expected: The call is at 4 PM.

cases.note: Chained corrections: only the last value survives.
cases.input: Let's meet at 2 PM, actually 3 PM, no wait, 4 PM.
cases.expected: Let's meet at 4 PM.

cases.input: Send the report to Rahul. Scratch that, send it to Priya.
cases.expected: Send it to Priya.

cases.note: Only the corrected sentence changes; the text around it is kept.

cases.expected: Hi team. The total is 6,000 rupees. Thanks.

cases.note: Not clearly a correction, so both parts are kept.

cases.expected: I actually like the new design.
